title: Relaxed nanowire structure for Dc=4.0 Å
action: Simulate a Cu nanowire confined in a cylinder of 4.0 Å diameter using the SMA-TB potential and steepest descent relaxation; output relaxed atomic coordinates.
description: XYZ file of relaxed Cu atoms for Dc=4.0 Å
output_schema: Text file: first line = number of atoms, second line = comment, then one line per atom: 'Cu x y z' with coordinates in Ångströms, cylinder axis along z.

title: Relaxed nanowire structure for Dc=6.0 Å
action: Simulate a Cu nanowire confined in a cylinder of 6.0 Å diameter using the SMA-TB potential and steepest descent relaxation; output relaxed atomic coordinates.
description: XYZ file of relaxed Cu atoms for Dc=6.0 Å

title: Extract structural indices and shell radii
action: From the three XYZ files, compute radial distances of atoms from z-axis, cluster into coaxial shells based on radial gaps, calculate average shell radii, assign KT and T indices, and output a JSON summary.
description: JSON summary of shell radii and structural indices for each diameter.
output_schema: JSON object with keys '4.0','6.0','12.0'. Each value is an object: { 'radii': [list of numbers, inner to outer, in Å], 'KT_index': string (e.g. '5-1'), 'T_indices': [list of strings (e.g. '(5,0)','(1,1)')] }.
